strings.data.miniBossDialogue.miniboss_shadow_we: The forest whispers... can you hear it? Every tree, every leaf in the Twilight Forest carries my messages.
I am the Shadow Weaver, manipulator of dark threads. It was I who summoned the undead army, cloaking this forest in eternal twilight.
Deep within the forest lies an ancient seal, and you... are unworthy of its secrets. Prepare for eternal darkness!
strings.data.miniBossDialogue.miniboss_iron_guar: The dwarven anvil... has been silent for a millennium. You tread upon this ancient domain and must face the guardian's judgment.
I am the Iron Guardian, forged by the ancient dwarves, charged with protecting the mountain ruins. All trespassers shall be reduced to scrap.
In the depths of these mountains sleeps the dwarven dynasty's last treasure. And you shall not leave here alive!
strings.data.miniBossDialogue.miniboss_sand_wrai: In the scorching sand winds... do you hear it? The wails of the souls from the desert kingdom destroyed a millennium ago.
I was once the desert kingdom's high priest, now an undead wraith. The fire rift's power gave me rebirth, and eternal curse.
Beneath these sands lies the truth of the kingdom's fall. You want to know? Then pay with your blood!
The desert's fury shall consume all... are you ready, adventurer?
strings.data.miniBossDialogue.miniboss_void_hera: The gate of the abyss is about to fully open... you are too late, mortal. The will of the void cannot be stopped.
I am the Void Herald, the first emissary of the abyss rift. Before the demon lord's arrival, my mission is to eliminate all obstacles.
You think sealing the abyss will save this world? Naive. The abyss's power has already seeped into every corner.
Come, let me witness humanity's final struggle! The void's darkness shall be your destination!
strings.data.hiddenArea.hidden_tf_moonlight_shri: Through a gap in the dense canopy, a beam of silver moonlight illuminates an ancient altar. This is the legendary Moonlight Shrine that can purify the undead!
strings.data.hiddenArea.hidden_am_dwarf_vault.di: You discovered a hidden dwarven stone door in the rock face! Behind it lies a long-sealed vault.
strings.data.hiddenArea.hidden_sd_buried_oasis.d: You discovered a buried ancient oasis among the sand dunes! Traces of a once-flourishing garden remain around the dried-up spring.
strings.data.hiddenArea.hidden_ar_sealed_chamber: You discovered a sealed chamber in the twisted spatial rift! It appears to be an emergency shelter left by the ancient sages, containing their relics.
Several armored skeletons scattered along a forest path. Their formation suggests a patrol squad. Badges on the armor identify them as the Forest Guardian Knights — the first to fall when twilight descended.
strings.data.storyDeco.story_tf_corrupted_shrine: A small shrine once dedicated to the forest god, now thoroughly corrupted by dark energy. The deity is barely recognizable, and faint purple mist seeps from the surrounding stones. Someone left withered flowers before it.
strings.data.storyDeco.story_tf_ancient_tree_stu: A massive ancient tree snapped in half, its stump wider than ten people could embrace. Faint green light emanates from the center — part of the forest's Tree of Life. Even destroyed, it stubbornly releases life energy.
strings.data.storyDeco.story_am_collapsed_bridge: A stone bridge that once spanned a canyon, now mostly collapsed. Exquisite dwarven reliefs on the pillars depict smiths forging legendary weapons. Cold wind howls from the abyss below.
strings.data.storyDeco.story_am_dwarf_statue.des: A three-meter-tall statue of a dwarven war king, wielding a warhammer in full armor. The inscription reads: "King of the Anvil, Bruun — his hammer echoes eternally through the mountains." Though damaged, it still exudes solemn grandeur.
A massive dwarven forge, its fire long extinguished. An unfinished battle axe remains in the hearth. Scattered dwarven tools suggest the smiths fled in haste, abandoning everything.
strings.data.storyDeco.story_sd_half_buried_pala: An ornate palace wall emerges from the sand dunes. Murals depict the desert kingdom's golden age — fountains, gardens, people in fine garments laughing in the sun. Now all is buried beneath sand.
strings.data.storyDeco.story_sd_fire_scarred_gro: A deep crack in the ground with edges scorched by extreme heat. Hot air laden with sulfur occasionally rises from the depths. This is the scar left when the fire rift tore the earth apart.
strings.data.storyDeco.story_sd_scorpion_nest_re: A massive desert scorpion's exoskeleton scattered across the sand — the pincers alone are taller than a person. These are remains of an ancient giant scorpion; warriors of the desert kingdom once battled these behemoths.
strings.data.storyDeco.story_ar_corrupted_seal.d: A massive magic array carved into the ground, corrupted beyond recognition by dark purple energy. Faint golden light lingers at the edges — remnants of the ancient sages' sealing power. The array groans in pain with each void pulse.
strings.data.storyDeco.story_ar_frozen_warrior.d: A fully armored warrior frozen in place by some force, caught mid-swing. Terror distorts his face, and the seal guardian's crest adorns his armor. The void's time-warping power froze him forever in his final battle.
strings.data.storyDeco.story_ar_demon_war_banner: A massive flag of dark red leather bearing the Demon Lord's crest. It flutters eerily in the windless void, emitting an unsettling low hum. This war banner was planted when the demon army invaded the mortal realm.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_forest.name: The Endless Dusk
strings.data.quest.q_explore_forest.desc: The Twilight Forest has slept in dusk for centuries, and now its dead are rising. Scout the northern woods, the abandoned graveyard and the ancient ruins.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_undead.name: The Restless Dead
strings.data.quest.q_kill_undead.desc: The dead are held by the darkness and cannot rest. Shatter the skeletons and burn the ghouls, and return them to the earth.
strings.data.quest.q_talk_hermit.name: The Erased Name
strings.data.quest.q_talk_hermit.desc: The hermit deep in the forest guards a forgotten history. Find him and learn the truth about the risen dead and the seals.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_werewolf_alpha.name: The Moon-Eater
strings.data.quest.q_kill_werewolf_alpha.desc: Volgan, the Moon Priestess's sacred wolf, was twisted by the whispers into a werewolf king and now guards the road to the dark source. Defeat him and set him free.
strings.data.quest.q_seal_dark_source.name: The Moon Seal
strings.data.quest.q_seal_dark_source.desc: The dark source is the corrupted Moon Seal, tangled with the Tree of Life. Cut through the ghouls and rekindle the second seal with the brand's fire.
strings.data.quest.q_collect_wolf_pelts.name: Bounty: One-Eyed Greymane
strings.data.quest.q_collect_wolf_pelts.desc: The forest hunter has tracked a one-eyed werewolf for three long winters. They call it Greymane; it lairs in the wolf den to the southwest and has killed two of the hunter's apprentices. Skin it and settle the debt.
strings.data.quest.q_spider_nest.name: Lanterns for the Lost
strings.data.quest.q_spider_nest.desc: The spirit medium says the ghosts in the graveyard mean no harm; they simply can't find their way back. Light the soul lanterns in the abandoned graveyard and show them the path.
strings.data.quest.q_lost_scout.name: The Scout Who Didn't Return
strings.data.quest.q_lost_scout.desc: The scout sent out three days ago never came back. The hunter found his tracks southeast of the camp. Follow the trail and find him, whatever you find.
strings.data.quest.q_ancient_relic.name: A Message for the Hermit
strings.data.quest.q_ancient_relic.desc: The spirit medium heard words from the dead that must reach the forest hermit. Once he has heard them, he will have a message of his own for the scout captain at camp. Play messenger.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_dwarf_ruins.name: The Silent Anvil
strings.data.quest.q_explore_dwarf_ruins.desc: A century ago an earthquake tore the Anvil Mountains apart and the dwarves abandoned their city. Explore the mine entrance, the forge hall and the dwarven throne, and see what has become of their home.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_gargoyles.name: Stone Wings
strings.data.quest.q_kill_gargoyles.desc: A century ago, the "earthquake" woke the gargoyles, and now they hold the peaks and choke the trade road. Smash them and open the way to the ruins.
strings.data.quest.q_collect_dwarf_relics.name: Relics of the King
strings.data.quest.q_collect_dwarf_relics.desc: King Bruun's mithril ingots sit in the bellies of stone golems, and his rune fragments are lodged in the gargoyles. Take them back to prepare for the reforging.
strings.data.quest.q_reforge_artifact.name: The Hammer of Fate
strings.data.quest.q_reforge_artifact.desc: The Hammer of Fate forged the five seals, and it can forge a new key. Recover mithril cores and bring King Bruun's hammer back into the light.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_stone_guardian.name: The Usurper
strings.data.quest.q_kill_stone_guardian.desc: The troll Gorm squats on the dwarven throne, and beneath it lies the Anvil Seal, eaten through by whispers. Defeat him and rekindle the third seal.
strings.data.quest.q_crystal_mining.name: Crystal Vein
strings.data.quest.q_crystal_mining.desc: The old miner spotted a crystal vein exposed on the northern slope, but gargoyles circle right overhead. Chip the crystals loose while they aren't looking.
strings.data.quest.q_mountain_bandits.name: Bounty: Rockbreaker
strings.data.quest.q_mountain_bandits.desc: An ancient stone golem has gone rogue; the dwarves call it Rockbreaker. It rampages through the eastern hollow and has already caved in three mine shafts. The rune scholar wants the runes in its core, if someone can smash it open.
strings.data.quest.q_trapped_miners.name: After the Cave-In
strings.data.quest.q_trapped_miners.desc: A tunnel to the south has collapsed, and a miner with a crushed leg is trapped where stone golems roam. Find him and escort him back to the old miner.
strings.data.quest.q_dragon_egg.name: The Roost Mother's Egg
strings.data.quest.q_dragon_egg.desc: The miners swear there is a "dragon egg" on the northern peak. The dwarven elder doesn't believe it, but he wants to know what it really is. Storm the gargoyle roost, defeat the Roost Mother guarding it, and bring the egg to the rune scholar.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_desert.name: The Burning Sea of Sand
strings.data.quest.q_explore_desert.desc: The Scorching Desert was once the realm of the Sun Crown Kingdom; now fire rules it. Explore the Fire Wastes and Scorpion Valley and learn this sea of sand.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_fire_elementals.name: Masterless Flame
strings.data.quest.q_kill_fire_elementals.desc: Shards of Abyssfire escaping the fire rift have become fire elementals that roam the dunes, turning sand to glass. Put them out and let the desert breathe.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_oasis.name: Memory of the Spring
strings.data.quest.q_explore_oasis.desc: The hidden oasis was once the royal garden of the Sun Crown Kingdom. Go there, listen to the spring, and learn how the kingdom fell.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_sandworms.name: Road-Eaters
strings.data.quest.q_kill_sandworms.desc: Driven to the surface by the heat below, sandworms have swallowed the southern trade road. Clear them out and open the way to the fire rift.
strings.data.quest.q_seal_fire_rift.name: The Sun Seal
strings.data.quest.q_seal_fire_rift.desc: The Sun Seal is broken, and Helia, the queen's sacred bird, is enslaved by the Abyssfire and fans the rift's flames. Defeat her so she may rise from her ashes, and rekindle the fourth seal.
strings.data.quest.q_water_supply.name: Seeking the Spring
strings.data.quest.q_water_supply.desc: The water diviner's dowsing rod won't stop trembling over the western sands: there is a spring down there. Follow the rod to three patches of damp sand; the spring lies beneath the last. Only, something seems to have claimed it first.
strings.data.quest.q_scorpion_venom.name: Bounty: Syss the Venom Queen
strings.data.quest.q_scorpion_venom.desc: The nomads' camel trains keep dying in the rocky valley to the east, every corpse marked with the same purple-black blotches: the venom of Syss, mother of the scorpion swarm. Cut out her venom sac; the nomads will make an antidote from it.
strings.data.quest.q_buried_treasure.name: The Tablet Beneath the Sand
strings.data.quest.q_buried_treasure.desc: The archaeologist unearthed a stone tablet covered in ancient script, but it has broken into pieces scattered through the sand around the ruins. Gather the shards and take them to the nomad chief, the only one who can still read that script.
strings.data.quest.q_mirage_beasts.name: Mirage Twins
strings.data.quest.q_mirage_beasts.desc: Two identical flames often appear in the heat haze to the north, and travelers who chase them never return. The water diviner says they are no illusion but a pair of bonded fire spirits. Walk into the mirage and snuff them both out.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_abyss.name: Gate of the Abyssfire
strings.data.quest.q_explore_abyss.desc: The fires of five lands all flow here. Explore the rift entrance, the Demon Spire and the Throne of Chaos, and learn Ignaroth's ground.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_demons.name: The Tide Through the Gate
strings.data.quest.q_kill_demons.desc: Every inch the gate opens lets more demons through. Drive back the imps and lesser demons, and let none cross the rift.
strings.data.quest.q_collect_demon_essence.name: The Abyss as Binding
strings.data.quest.q_collect_demon_essence.desc: Lock the Abyssfire's gate with things of the Abyssfire: that was Aethelyn's way. Hunt the demons of the Abyss and collect their essence to bind the Final Key.
strings.data.quest.q_forge_seal.name: The Final Key
strings.data.quest.q_forge_seal.desc: Seal fragments lie scattered near the Heroes' Memorial, bought with generations of wardens' lives. Gather them and forge the Final Key with the Hammer of Fate.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_abyss_lord.name: The Oathburner
strings.data.quest.q_kill_abyss_lord.desc: Ignaroth, the sixth sage whose name was erased, sits on the Throne of Chaos as the Abyss Lord. With the Final Key and the fire of your brand, end a thousand years of ruin.
strings.data.quest.q_corrupted_souls.name: The Three Oathbreakers
strings.data.quest.q_corrupted_souls.desc: Three of the fallen knight's old soldiers swore their oaths to the demons, and now each holds a corner of the abyss. He cannot bring himself to end them, so he entrusts it to you.
strings.data.quest.q_void_crystals.name: Void Crystals
strings.data.quest.q_void_crystals.desc: The void researcher has found crystals growing along the rift's edge that seem to "breathe". Harvest them for his research before they grow into the next tear.
strings.data.quest.q_fallen_hero.name: The Heroes' Last Words
strings.data.quest.q_fallen_hero.desc: Half of a last message is carved at the Fallen Shrine and half on the Heroes' Memorial, left by those who sealed the abyss three hundred years ago. Take rubbings of both inscriptions and bring them to the Abyss Warden.
strings.data.quest.q_demon_weaponry.name: Quartermaster Morax
strings.data.quest.q_demon_weaponry.desc: Every weapon of the demon legion comes from an armory camp to the south, guarded by Quartermaster Morax. Kill him and take his war sigil, and the warden will be able to read the demons' marching orders.
strings.data.quest.q_pet_jade_tortoise.name: The Jade Tortoise's Trial
strings.data.quest.q_pet_jade_tortoise.desc: The old miner says the soul of an ancient tortoise sleeps in these mountains. Gather the soul shards scattered around the old shrine and its guardian statue will wake to test you. Win, and it will follow you.
strings.data.quest.q_escort_survivor_desert.name: Escort the Survivor
strings.data.quest.q_escort_survivor_desert.desc: An explorer is lost and badly injured in the desert. Escort them through Scorpion Valley to the oasis camp. Watch for scorpions and fire elementals.
strings.data.quest.q_defend_camp_forest.name: Defend the Camp
strings.data.quest.q_defend_camp_forest.desc: The Twilight Forest camp has received intel: an undead army approaches! Hold the campfire and repel three waves. If the campfire is destroyed, all is lost.
strings.data.quest.q_defend_seal_abyss.name: Protect the Seal
strings.data.quest.q_defend_seal_abyss.desc: The abyssal seal is under demon attack! Repel five demon waves to protect the seal stone. If it shatters, the abyss will expand again.
strings.data.quest.q_investigate_ruins_mountains: The dwarven elder wants you to investigate ancient ruins in the Anvil Mountains. Find four hidden rune steles and record their inscriptions.
strings.data.quest.q_investigate_corruption_fore: The corruption in the forest keeps spreading, and the spirit medium suspects something is feeding it. Follow three traces of corruption, find the source, and root it out.
strings.data.quest.q_craft_dwarf_weapon.name: Forge the Dwarven Warhammer
strings.data.quest.q_craft_dwarf_weapon.desc: The dwarven elder wants to reforge a legendary warhammer. First collect mithril ingots and rune fragments, forge the weapon at the advanced blacksmith, then deliver it to the elder.
strings.data.quest.q_craft_fire_ward.name: Craft Fire Ward
strings.data.quest.q_craft_fire_ward.desc: The desert nomad needs a fire ward to resist the heat. Collect purified water skins and scorpion venom, craft the ward at the desert merchant, then deliver it to the nomad.
strings.data.questObj.q_lost_scout.badge: Bring the badge to the Scout Captain
strings.data.questObj.q_ancient_relic.hermit: Carry the message to the Forest Hermit
strings.data.questObj.q_ancient_relic.scout: Pass word to the Scout Captain
strings.data.questTarget.mountain_rune_scholar: Bring the egg to the Rune Scholar
strings.data.questTarget.quest_nomad: Have the Nomad read the tablet
strings.data.questTarget.quest_warden: Give the rubbings to the Abyss Warden
strings.data.questClue.clue_scout_bow: His longbow is snapped in two, the quiver empty. He fought to the last arrow.
strings.data.questClue.clue_scout_blood: The blood has gone black and drags away downhill. Something took him.
strings.data.questClue.clue_scout_cloak: The cloak is covered in teeth marks. Chewing sounds drift up from below...
strings.data.questClue.clue_spring_1: The rod shakes hardest here. Water murmurs beneath the sand, flowing south.
strings.data.questClue.clue_spring_2: The sand comes up damp in your hand. The vein turns southeast, toward the rocks.
strings.data.questClue.clue_spring_3: Water seeps from the crack, but something huge stirs below, gulping the spring down...
strings.data.questClue.clue_hero_shrine: The first half reads: "The fire cannot be put out, only brought home—"
strings.data.questClue.clue_hero_memorial: The second half reads: "—so let the Flamekeeper make a hearth of the heart."
strings.data.questClue.clue_corrupt_1: The roots rot from the inside out; black sap trickles east toward the water.
strings.data.questClue.clue_corrupt_2: Rotting flesh floats on the water. The dark current seeps in from the southwest.
strings.data.questClue.clue_corrupt_3: The flesh on the altar still pulses. The mother that feeds it is waking!
strings.data.questClue.clue_rune_1: First verse: "By the hammer we swear..." The next stele lies east.
strings.data.questClue.clue_rune_2: Second verse: "By the fire we bind..." Another waits deep in the mine.
strings.data.questClue.clue_rune_3: Third verse: "The mountain is its coffin..." The last is on the summit.
strings.data.questClue.clue_rune_4: Final verse: "...never to wake." Together the four form a sealing chant.
strings.data.npc.blacksmith.name: Hald Swordmelter
strings.data.npc.blacksmith.dialogue.0: Every tang has a name on it. I melt the sword and give the name to the Captain.
strings.data.npc.merchant.name: Quartermaster Vira
strings.data.npc.merchant.dialogue.0: One name, one ration saved. Three saved tonight.
strings.data.npc.stash.name: Tamsin the Gravewarden
strings.data.npc.stash.dialogue.0: I keep the dead's things for them. The living's too.
strings.data.npc.quest_elder.name: Captain Serin Harrow
strings.data.npc.quest_elder.dialogue.0: Out of the pit and on your feet. Then you can hold a blade.
strings.data.npc.quest_scout.name: Scout
strings.data.npc.quest_scout.dialogue.0: Something ominous stirs in the Twilight Forest...
strings.data.npc.forest_hermit.name: Forest Hermit
strings.data.npc.forest_hermit.dialogue.0: You finally found me... The undead's source is the dark energy deep within the forest.
strings.data.npc.forest_hermit.dialogue.1: Find that dark source, or the entire forest will fall.
strings.data.npc.blacksmith_advanced.name: Master Blacksmith
strings.data.npc.blacksmith_advanced.dialogue.0: Only the finest materials are worthy of my craft.
strings.data.npc.quest_dwarf.name: Dwarven Elder
strings.data.npc.quest_dwarf.dialogue.0: These mountains were once our home...
strings.data.npc.quest_dwarf.dialogue.1: Help us reclaim our ancestors' ruins.
strings.data.npc.quest_nomad.name: Desert Nomad
strings.data.npc.quest_nomad.dialogue.0: The scorching desert is fraught with danger...
strings.data.npc.quest_nomad.dialogue.1: Only the bravest can survive here.
strings.data.npc.quest_warden.name: Abyss Warden
strings.data.npc.quest_warden.dialogue.0: The Abyss Rift is expanding, demons are about to flood in...
strings.data.npc.quest_warden.dialogue.1: We need your power to seal it.
strings.data.npc.merchant_desert.name: Desert Merchant
strings.data.npc.merchant_desert.dialogue.0: Water is more precious than gold in the desert...
strings.data.npc.merchant_desert.dialogue.1: But I have everything you need.
strings.data.npc.plains_herbalist.name: Mother Marl
strings.data.npc.plains_herbalist.dialogue.0: Don't touch the black blood. The ones who did stopped hurting. That's the worst of it.
strings.data.npc.plains_wanderer.name: Corran the Deserter
strings.data.npc.plains_wanderer.dialogue.0: I ran and I lived. Which is the greater shame?
strings.data.npc.forest_tracker.name: Forest Hunter
strings.data.npc.forest_tracker.dialogue.0: Shh! Keep it down... the Twilight Forest is full of predators' ears.
strings.data.npc.forest_tracker.dialogue.1: Since the dark energy spread, even ordinary wolves have become vicious werewolves.
strings.data.npc.forest_tracker.dialogue.2: I'm tracking a massive shadow wolf. Its den lies in the dark cavern to the south. Go look if you dare.
strings.data.npc.forest_spirit_medium.name: Spirit Medium
strings.data.npc.forest_spirit_medium.dialogue.0: Do you feel it?... The departed souls are crying.
strings.data.npc.forest_spirit_medium.dialogue.1: The Twilight Forest's undead are not evil — they are poor souls trapped by dark forces.
strings.data.npc.forest_spirit_medium.dialogue.2: Deep in the forest lies a forgotten Moonlight Shrine that might purify them... but powerful undead guard it.
strings.data.npc.mountain_miner.name: Old Miner
strings.data.npc.mountain_miner.dialogue.0: Cough... the dust in these mines gets worse by the day.
strings.data.npc.mountain_miner.dialogue.1: Young one, the Anvil Mountains' depths hide the dwarven dynasty's treasury.
strings.data.npc.mountain_miner.dialogue.2: But since the gargoyles took the upper tunnels, nobody dares go deeper. I found an abandoned tunnel entrance to the west — it might lead to the treasury...
strings.data.npc.mountain_rune_scholar.name: Rune Scholar
Dwarven rune-inscribing techniques are unmatched in the world.
Every stone in these mountains may bear ancient runes. I'm studying an ancient code that activates dwarven mechanisms.
If you find any rune-inscribed tablets while exploring, please tell me — they are crucial to my research.
strings.data.npc.desert_archaeologist.name: Desert Archaeologist
strings.data.npc.desert_archaeologist.dialogue.0: An entire ancient civilization lies buried beneath these sands!
strings.data.npc.desert_archaeologist.dialogue.1: I've excavated dozens of artifacts, but the most important discovery is an underground temple half-buried beneath a dune.
strings.data.npc.desert_archaeologist.dialogue.2: The temple entrance is to the southeast. Inside may lie the desert kingdom's last secret treasure... but it's also full of undead guards.
strings.data.npc.desert_water_diviner.name: Water Diviner
strings.data.npc.desert_water_diviner.dialogue.0: In the scorching desert, water is life.
strings.data.npc.desert_water_diviner.dialogue.1: I can sense the flow of underground water veins. This desert wasn't always so barren — a thousand years ago it had oases and gardens.
strings.data.npc.desert_water_diviner.dialogue.2: To the north lies an ancient oasis site buried by sandstorms. If you look carefully, you might find the ruins of the ancient spring.
strings.data.npc.abyss_fallen_knight.name: Fallen Knight
strings.data.npc.abyss_fallen_knight.dialogue.0: Don't come near me... I've been corrupted by the void.
strings.data.npc.abyss_fallen_knight.dialogue.1: I was once a seal guardian. The abyss whispers day and night, eroding every guardian's will.
strings.data.npc.abyss_fallen_knight.dialogue.2: At the rift's deepest point lies a demon altar. Without destroying it, the seal can never be repaired. But going there... is suicide.
strings.data.npc.abyss_void_researcher.name: Void Researcher
Fascinating... and terrifying. Void energy follows entirely different laws.
I risked my life coming here to collect void crystal samples. These crystals contain the power to warp space.
There's an area to the east with especially concentrated void energy where space has begun to distort. I left some markers — you can go explore.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_elder.root.text: Out of the pit and on your feet. Then you can hold a blade.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_elder.help.text: The burial trenches, north. The burial detail hasn't come back.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_elder.help.choice.1: And the wheat below the walls?
strings.data.dialogue.quest_elder.reward_ask.tex: Pay? This is a dead man's pay. Take it; he won't need it.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_elder.farewell.text: Be back before dark. After dark the gate stays shut.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.root.text: Shh... you came at the right time. Strange things are happening in the Twilight Forest. Undead wander at night, and even veteran hunters dare not venture deep.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.root.choice.1: I need to explore the forest first
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.undead_explain: About a week ago, skeletons and zombies started appearing near the abandoned graveyard. Just a few at first, now the entire north has fallen. Some say it's dark magic.
Tell me more about the dark magic
Caution is wise. The forest has several areas — the northern woods, the abandoned graveyard, and the ancient ruins. Each may hold clues. Take this, it may help.
Thanks for the supplies, I'll scout the areas
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.clues.text: A scout I sent out hasn't come back in three days. The hunter found his tracks southeast of camp. Also, there's a hermit deep in the forest who knows it inside out.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.investigate_gr: The graveyard is to the west. But I suggest you familiarize yourself with the entire forest first to avoid getting lost. The thick fog here is no joke.
Right, I'll do a full survey first
I have experience, straight to the graveyard
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.clear_undead.t: Good idea! Clear the wandering undead first. Skeletons and zombies are most common. Destroying them will slow the spread.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.dark_magic.tex: Village elders say an ancient dark force is sealed beneath this forest. If the seal breaks... the consequences are unthinkable. The hermit deep in the forest may know more.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.dark_magic.cho: I need to find the hermit
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.accept_explore: Move carefully. Forest werewolves are especially active at night, and skeleton patrols roam in groups. Mark any anomalies you find.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.dangerous_area: The graveyard is most dangerous with the highest undead density. The ruins are also perilous with stronger guardians. The northern woods are relatively safe but have wolf packs.
I'll start with the safe areas
Straight to the most dangerous spot
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.accept_scout.t: The tracks run downhill. Find him... and whatever you find, bring his badge back to me.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.hermit_locatio: The hermit lives in a small cabin in the forest's southeast corner. He's eccentric but very knowledgeable. He should know the true cause of the undead uprising.
I'll finish my current tasks first
Good luck, hero. The cabin is hard to find — look for ancient stone pillar markers to the southeast.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_scout.farewell.text: Come back anytime. I'll be here waiting for your report.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.root.text: Welcome to the Anvil Mountains. This was once my people's glorious home... until gargoyles and trolls seized our ruins.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.root.choice.1: I'm here to help you reclaim the ruins
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.root.choice.2: What treasure is in the mountains?
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.history.text: A century ago, an earthquake awakened a swarm of sleeping gargoyles. They attacked our mines and forge halls, forcing us to retreat to the foothill camp. Only a few old dwarves remember that era.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.history.choice: It's time to reclaim our home
I heard there are dragon eggs?
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.reclaim.text: Really? Wonderful! First you need to learn the ruins' layout. The mine entrance, forge hall, and dwarven throne are three key areas.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.treasure.text: Our treasure isn't gold — it's mithril, a metal tougher and lighter than steel. If you can recover the mithril veins, I can forge you a weapon. Take this gold as a show of good faith.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.weakness.text: Gargoyles grow sluggish during daytime but fiercer in darkness. Their stone skin resists physical attacks, but magic works much better.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.weakness.choic: Got it, I'll take them on
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.intel.text: The mine entrance is in the northern mountains — fewest gargoyles. The forge hall is in the central area with many stone golems. The dwarven throne in the south has the strongest guardians.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.accept_explore: Good luck. The mountain passages are labyrinthine — mark your path. Come back if you run into trouble.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.accept_gargoyl: Slaying 15 gargoyles should greatly weaken their forces. They mainly perch on high points and passage intersections.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.dragon_egg.tex: Hmph, the miners keep going on about a "dragon egg" on the north peak. Three hundred years I've lived and never seen a dragon. But the gargoyle roost up there is guarding something... if you have the nerve, go and look.
The roost is on the east side of the north peak, and a big brute guards it. Kill it and take that "egg" to the rune scholar. I want to know what it really is.
The forge hall holds our ancestors' rune tablets. And the old miner says a fresh crystal vein has broken open on the north slope. Crystals can enchant weapons; very precious.
I'll mine crystals on the north slope
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.accept_crystal: The vein is on the north slope, with gargoyles circling overhead. Be quick: chip off 6 while they aren't looking and take them to the old miner.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_dwarf.farewell.text: No worries. The Anvil Mountains can wait. Come back when you're ready.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.root.text: Traveler, you crossed the sandstorm to get here... you're braver than most. The Scorching Desert is being devoured by flames.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.root.choice.0: Flames? Isn't this a normal desert?
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.root.choice.1: I'm here to explore this desert
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.root.choice.2: How do you nomads survive here?
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.fire_explain.t: No, this isn't normal. A fire rift deep in the desert keeps expanding, releasing fire elementals. If it's not sealed, the entire desert will become a lava hellscape.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.fire_explain.c: I'll help you seal the rift
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.explore.text: Brave! The desert has two main areas: the Flame Wastes with many fire elementals, and Scorpion Valley infested with giant scorpions.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.explore.choice: Is there water in the desert?
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.survival.text: We survive at the oasis — the desert's only safe water source. But fire elementals are encroaching on it lately.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.survival.choic: I can help protect the oasis
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.seal_path.text: To seal the rift: first eliminate fire elementals to weaken the fire, then find the ancient power at the hidden oasis, and finally defeat the phoenix guarding the rift.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.seal_path.choi: Let me learn the terrain first
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.fire_danger.te: Fire elementals are immune to fire damage and resist physical attacks. Ice magic is the best counter. Their core is in their center — smash it to destroy them.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.fire_danger.ch: Got it, I'll go fight them
I need to prepare ice equipment first
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.simple_tasks.t: Of course. The water diviner's rod keeps trembling over the western sands; he says there's a spring below and needs someone to find it. And in the eastern valley, Syss, mother of scorpions, is still killing our caravans. Take these desert supplies.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.simple_tasks.c: I'll help the diviner find the spring (receive supplies)
I'll hunt Syss the Venom Queen
Let me learn about the desert first
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.accept_explore: Daytime sandstorms will block your vision — move between storms. Remember, if you're lost, head east. The oasis is to the southeast.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.water.text: There's no natural water in the desert, only at the oasis. But the diviner says a spring lies hidden beneath the western sands, though something seems to have claimed it first.
If you truly want to help, start by eliminating desert fire elementals. They're the biggest threat to the oasis.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.oasis_location: The oasis is hidden behind sand dunes in the southeast. Ancient temple ruins there may hold clues to sealing the fire.
I'll head to the oasis now
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.accept_oasis.t: Watch out for sandworms near the oasis — they move underground and appear suddenly.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.accept_fire.te: Slay 12 fire elementals to weaken the rift's power. They mainly appear in the Flame Wastes.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.accept_water.t: Follow the diviner's rod to three patches of damp sand; the spring lies at the last. Careful: whatever holds it won't give it up easily.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.accept_venom.t: Syss lairs in the eastern valley, always with a few scorpions at her side. Cut out her venom sac and bring it back; we'll make antidote from it. Don't let her stinger touch you!
strings.data.dialogue.quest_nomad.farewell.text: The desert won't wait, traveler. I hope you can help next time.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.root.text: You... you actually came to the edge of the Abyss Rift. This is the boundary between the mortal realm and hell. The demon army is assembling — we don't have much time.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.root.choice.0: How did the Abyss Rift form?
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.root.choice.1: I'm here to seal the rift
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.origin.text: A millennium ago, a fallen archmage opened a portal to the abyss for eternal power. Our predecessors sealed it, but the seal is crumbling. Without resealing, demons will flood the mortal world.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.origin.choice: Tell me how to seal it
Where is the fallen mage now?
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.seal_plan.tex: To reseal the rift: one, explore three major areas to find seal fragments; two, slay demons for their essence as seal material; three, defeat the Abyss Lord, the core power maintaining the rift.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.danger.text: Extremely dangerous. The abyss has imps, lesser demons, succubi... and the Abyss Lord himself. Even the air is corrosive — ordinary people can't last a moment. Make sure you're strong enough.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.danger.choice: Anything to help resist the corruption?
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.fallen_mage.t: He is no longer human. After a millennium of abyssal corruption, he became the Abyss Lord — the most powerful demon in this realm. To seal the rift, he must be defeated.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.accept_explor: The rift entrance is to the north, the Demon Spire to the east, and the Throne of Chaos in the deep south. Each area has seal fragment clues. Don't linger too long in the abyss.
Brave! But don't be reckless. First eliminate nearby imps and lesser demons to collect demon essence for the seal.
I'll also harvest crystals for the void researcher
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.prepare.text: Wise. Prepare on the outskirts first: the fallen knight has three oathbreaking soldiers who must be ended, and the void researcher needs someone to harvest the crystals on the rift's edge. Here are the wardens' emergency supplies.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.prepare.choic: Thanks for the supplies. I'll end the three oathbreakers
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.resistance.te: Void crystals may hold off the corrosion of the abyss; the void researcher is studying them. And those who sealed the abyss three hundred years ago left their last words on the shrine and the memorial. Understanding them would serve you better than any armor.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.resistance.ch: I'll take rubbings of the heroes' words
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.encourage.tex: I understand your concern. But remember, you're not fighting alone. The whole world depends on heroes like you. Every demon slain weakens the rift.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.encourage.cho: You're right, I won't back down
I need to get stronger first
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.accept_demons: Slay 20 imps and 10 lesser demons. They mainly gather near the rift entrance and Demon Spire. Watch out for succubi's charm magic!
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.accept_crysta: The crystals grow along the eastern edge of the rift, breathing like living things. Harvest 5 for the void researcher before they grow into a new tear.
Karon, Lyss and Gig were once the knight's finest soldiers. Each holds a corner of the abyss, with imps at their side. Show no mercy; they are no longer human.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.crystal_locat: They grow along the rift edge in the eastern abyss, where space is most twisted. They breathe and glow faint purple, so they are easy to spot. Five is enough.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.accept_hero.t: The Fallen Shrine lies in the southwest of the abyss, the Heroes' Memorial in the south-center. Each bears half of a last message. Take rubbings and bring them to me.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_warden.farewell.text: The abyss won't wait. Prepare quickly and come back.
strings.data.lore.lore_tf_01.name: Tree Spirit Inscription
strings.data.lore.lore_tf_01.text: Carved on this ancient tree's bark in tree-spirit script: "The Twilight Forest's eternal night is no natural phenomenon. Centuries ago, a powerful wizard fused himself with the Tree of Life seeking immortality, accidentally releasing dark energy and plunging the forest into eternal twilight."
strings.data.lore.lore_tf_02.name: Rune Pillar
strings.data.lore.lore_tf_02.text: A moss-covered rune pillar emitting an eerie glow. The runes read: "The key to sealing the darkness lies in three altars deep in the forest. When all three are lit simultaneously, darkness will be dispelled and light will return to the forest." The altars' locations have been deliberately erased.
strings.data.lore.lore_tf_03.name: Undead Notebook
strings.data.lore.lore_tf_03.text: A notebook corroded by dark energy: "I am the last human to witness the forest's transformation. The Shadow Weaver was not born evil — she was once a forest-guarding elf corrupted by dark forces. Perhaps purifying her is the true way to save the forest."
strings.data.lore.lore_tf_04.name: Moonlight Fragment
strings.data.lore.lore_tf_04.text: A fragment glowing silver-white in the twilight. Legend says it's a relic of the ancient Moon Goddess, capable of dispelling darkness. Its surface reflects the forest's former self — sunlight through leaves, birdsong, vibrant life.
strings.data.lore.lore_am_01.name: Dwarven Inscription
strings.data.lore.lore_am_01.text: Precise dwarven inscription on this metal plate: "In the great forge of Anvil Mountains' seventh level, King Bruun forged the legendary Hammer of Destiny — said to forge anything, even repair broken ley-lines. After the cataclysm, the Hammer disappeared."
strings.data.lore.lore_am_02.name: Forge Journal
strings.data.lore.lore_am_02.text: A dwarven master smith's journal: "Day 321. The Iron Guardian's core is complete, but I found a fatal flaw — it only executes the last command given, unable to distinguish friend from foe. If the creator falls, it will forever execute the final order... attack everything."
strings.data.lore.lore_am_03.name: Gem Ore
strings.data.lore.lore_am_03.text: A raw ore containing multiple gemstones. Dwarves believe gems are the earth's tears, each sealing ancient memories. This ore seems to hold images of the Anvil Mountains' founding — thousands of dwarves working together to carve a magnificent underground city.
strings.data.lore.lore_am_04.name: Statue Inscription
strings.data.lore.lore_am_04.text: The inscription beside a fallen dwarven warrior statue: "Dedicated to the last guardians of the Anvil Mountains. When gargoyles seized the upper mountain, they gave their lives to buy time for civilians to retreat. May the hammer and anvil forever remember their sacrifice. — The Survivors' Alliance"
strings.data.lore.lore_sd_01.name: Desert Mural
strings.data.lore.lore_sd_01.text: An ancient mural half-buried in sand. It depicts a prosperous desert kingdom — soaring spires, flowing oases, richly dressed nobles. The final panel shows the earth splitting open, flames erupting from the cracks, the entire kingdom reduced to ruins overnight.
strings.data.lore.lore_sd_02.name: Priest Scroll
strings.data.lore.lore_sd_02.text: A barely preserved parchment scroll: "The fire rift was no natural disaster but a man-made catastrophe. The desert kingdom's high priest broke the fourth seal of the abyss for eternal power. The rift has since brought hellfire to the mortal realm; the kingdom fell, and the priest became an undead wraith."
strings.data.lore.lore_sd_03.name: Phoenix Fossil
strings.data.lore.lore_sd_03.text: A rare phoenix feather fossil, still radiating scorching heat. Legend says phoenixes are divine beasts born from the fire rift — both embodiments of destruction and symbols of rebirth. Desert nomads believe that as long as phoenixes exist, the desert still has hope for renewal.
strings.data.lore.lore_sd_04.name: Oasis Ruins Stele
strings.data.lore.lore_sd_04.text: A stele standing by the dried oasis: "This was once the desert kingdom's royal garden. Clear springs rose from underground, nurturing all life. When the fire rift tore the earth, underground water channels were burned dry, and the garden became scorched earth. — Desert Nomad Historian"
strings.data.lore.lore_ar_01.name: Abyssal Inscription
strings.data.lore.lore_ar_01.text: A stele wrapped in dark purple energy: "The Abyss Rift connects the mortal realm to the void. In ancient times, five sages set five seals to lock the abyssal gate. But with passing ages and cataclysms across the lands, the seals broke one by one. Only the last remains."
strings.data.lore.lore_ar_02.name: Fallen One's Last Letter
strings.data.lore.lore_ar_02.text: A letter corroded by void energy: "I am the descendant of the fifth guardian. My family has guarded the last seal for generations, but the void's corruption is too strong. My companions fell one by one, becoming demon servants. If you read this... please complete my mission, seal the abyssal gate. — The Last Guardian"
strings.data.lore.lore_ar_03.name: Void Crystal
strings.data.lore.lore_ar_03.text: A crystalline body emitting ominous purple light. When touched, fragmented images flash through your mind: a void demon lord gazing upon the mortal realm, countless demons waiting in darkness to be summoned. The crystal seems to warn — on the other side of the rift lies horror beyond imagination.
strings.data.lore.lore_ar_04.name: Seal Remnant Array
strings.data.lore.lore_ar_04.text: A broken magic array still flickering faintly. This is one of the five seals set by the ancient sages. Its center bears the inscription: "My blood for the lock, my soul for the key. Only when five arrays shine together can the abyssal gate be sealed forever." The array is mostly shattered; repair seems impossible.
strings.data.lore.lore_ar_05.name: Demon Covenant Tablet
strings.data.lore.lore_ar_05.text: A tablet covered in demon script. Most is illegible, but one translated passage is clear: "Those who sign a covenant with the abyss gain boundless power at the price of eternal soul damnation. The Void Herald was the first mortal to accept the covenant, and the Demon Lord's most loyal servant."
