strings.data.quest.q_explore_forest.offer: So you're the brand-bearer from the plains? The elder's letter came. The forest is wrong. Northern woods, old graveyard, ancient ruins: look at all three, then come back.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_forest.complete: The graveyard is the worst, and the dead there all kneel facing the same way: east. Worse than I thought.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_undead.offer: Skeletons and ghouls have cut every patrol route. Twelve skeletons, eight ghouls. Put them back in the ground. They were people once. Don't let them suffer more.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_undead.complete: Clean work. But the dead keep crawling out. A hermit lives in the east, older than the trees. He may know why.
strings.data.quest.q_talk_hermit.offer: The hermit lives at the far east of the forest. Odd man, shuns strangers. But he once said: if someone comes with fire in their hand, let them in. Go.
strings.data.quest.q_talk_hermit.complete: If the hermit let you in, the fire in your hand is real. Sit, have some water, and tell it slowly.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_werewolf_alpha.offer: The hermit says the wolf king was the Moon Priestess's sacred wolf. Now it guards the road to the dark source. Kill six werewolves to draw it out, then... make it quick.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_werewolf_alpha.complet: When the wolf king fell, it howled once more at the sky. Not in hate. More like thanks. The road is open.
strings.data.quest.q_seal_dark_source.offer: The dark source is in the southwest corner: the fouled Moon Seal. Ghouls pour out of it without end. Cut through them and press your fire into it.
strings.data.quest.q_seal_dark_source.complete: The forest is... bright? Centuries, and this is the first moonlight I've seen touch the ground.
strings.data.quest.q_defend_camp_forest.offer: Confirmed: the dead hit the camp tonight, three waves. If the campfire dies, the camp dies. Hold it.
strings.data.quest.q_defend_camp_forest.complete: Three waves held, fire still burning. Every soul in this camp owes you.
strings.data.quest.q_collect_wolf_pelts.offer: Shh... Greymane. One eye. The den to the southwest. Three winters, and it killed two of my apprentices. I'm too old to run it down now. Skin it for me.
strings.data.quest.q_collect_wolf_pelts.complete: That's its hide; I know the scar over that eye... My two boys can close their eyes now.
strings.data.quest.q_lost_scout.offer: The scout we sent out three days ago never came back. I found his tracks southeast of camp, heading downhill. Go find him... whatever you find.
strings.data.quest.q_lost_scout.complete: The captain showed me the badge. Rendjaw is dead too. He was a good scout; he didn't fall until his quiver was empty... Thank you for bringing him home.
strings.data.quest.q_spider_nest.offer: The ghosts in the graveyard mean no harm... they are only lost, and cannot find the way back. Light the soul lanterns and show them the path.
strings.data.quest.q_spider_nest.complete: I saw them... lantern after lantern, they followed the light home. The graveyard has never been so quiet.
strings.data.quest.q_investigate_corruption_fore: The corruption is in three places... the roots, the water, a shadow altar, and all three feed the same thing. Follow them to it, and root it out.
The Rot Mother is dead, and the forest breathes easier. But it did not grow on its own... someone summoned it.
strings.data.quest.q_ancient_relic.offer: The dead gave me words for the hermit: "The moon has not gone out; it waits for the fire." I cannot leave this graveyard... carry them for me. He will have words of his own for you to pass on.
strings.data.quest.q_ancient_relic.complete: The hermit's words have reached the scout captain too. The dead, the hermit, the living... this forest is bound together again.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_dwarf_ruins.offer: Hmph. Another one who says they'll save the mountain. Still, the fire in your hand is in our ancestors' inscriptions. Mine entrance, forge hall, throne. Go look, then report.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_dwarf_ruins.complet: Gargoyles on the heights, a troll on the throne, and beneath that throne lies the Anvil Seal. By my ancestors!
strings.data.quest.q_kill_gargoyles.offer: Those stone-winged vermin woke in the quake a hundred years ago. Only it was no quake: something turned over beneath the mountain. Smash fifteen and clear the road!
strings.data.quest.q_kill_gargoyles.complete: Ha! The heights are clear. Now bring back our ancestors' scattered relics. There's something I mean to reforge.
strings.data.quest.q_collect_dwarf_relics.offer: King Bruun's mithril ingots went down the golems' gullets, and the gargoyles carried his rune fragments all over the mountain. Take them back. Every last one!
strings.data.quest.q_collect_dwarf_relics.comple: Mithril, runes... half of what we need. Child, do you know what I mean to reforge? The Hammer of Fate.
strings.data.quest.q_reforge_artifact.offer: The Hammer of Fate: the very hammer that forged the five seals! All it lacks is mithril cores. They grow inside trolls and golems. Bring me three!
strings.data.quest.q_reforge_artifact.complete: The hammer's heart is beating... no, it's beating in time with your brand! Quick, stand at the forge.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_stone_guardian.offer: That dim-witted troll Gorm won't budge from our throne. The Anvil Seal beneath it is whispering to him. Knock him off and rekindle the seal with the Hammer and your fire!
strings.data.quest.q_kill_stone_guardian.complet: The throne is ours again! No dwarf will ever forget you. But the smoke over the southern desert has grown taller.
strings.data.quest.q_dragon_egg.offer: Hmph, a dragon egg? Miners will say anything after enough ale. But that gargoyle roost on the north peak is guarding something fiercely... kill the brood mother and take the "egg" to the rune scholar.
strings.data.quest.q_dragon_egg.complete: The scholar says it's a gargoyle egg, and something is still beating inside the stone. Hah, I said there was no dragon! ...Still, better that thing never hatches.
strings.data.quest.q_craft_dwarf_weapon.offer: I will reforge the warhammer of my ancestors' guard! Ingots from golems, rune fragments from gargoyles. Take them to the master smith, then bring it to me.
strings.data.quest.q_craft_dwarf_weapon.complete: That's the weight! The old guard's hammer is back in dwarven hands. Take this fine weapon, and don't shame it.
strings.data.quest.q_crystal_mining.offer: *cough* A crystal vein's broken open on the north slope, bright enough to blind you. But gargoyles circle right over it, and my old legs won't make the climb. You're quick. Chip off six while they're not looking.
strings.data.quest.q_crystal_mining.complete: Fine crystals! Enchant a blade with these and it'll bite deeper. *cough* Keep this sapphire for your trouble.
strings.data.quest.q_trapped_miners.offer: The southern tunnel's caved in! Young Pebble's got a crushed leg and he's stuck where the golems roam. Please, get him out and bring him home safe!
strings.data.quest.q_trapped_miners.complete: Pebble's back, and the leg will mend... *cough* I'll not forget this as long as I live.
strings.data.quest.q_pet_jade_tortoise.offer: The old folk say the soul of an ancient tortoise sleeps in these mountains. Its soul shards lie scattered by the old shrine. Gather them, and its guardian statue will wake to test you. Win, and it's yours.
strings.data.quest.q_pet_jade_tortoise.complete: The guardian crumbled, and the tortoise... smiled? Look at the jade glow on its shell! It follows you now. Treat it well.
strings.data.quest.q_mountain_bandits.offer: Rockbreaker! A rogue golem of ancient make, and it has already brought down three mine shafts. Its core may hold the last intact guardian inscription. Please smash it, but do not smash the core!
strings.data.quest.q_mountain_bandits.complete: The core is intact! Look at these runes... it didn't go rogue, it was rewritten: "guard the mountain" carved over into "break the mountain". Fascinating. And terrifying.
strings.data.quest.q_investigate_ruins_mountains: Four rune steles are hidden in these mountains: north, east, in the mine, and on the summit. Find them and record the inscriptions.
The four pieces fit! It's a sealing incantation... what were the dwarves sealing? Fascinating.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_desert.offer: The sand speaks, but strangers cannot hear it. The fire in your hand, though, the sand knows. Walk the Fire Wastes and Scorpion Valley. Learn the face of this desert.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_desert.complete: You bring word from the wind. The fire in the wastes burns upward from below, like a furnace that never goes out.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_fire_elementals.offer: The fire elementals are shards of Abyssfire leaking from the rift. Sand turns to glass where they walk. Snuff out twelve and let the desert breathe.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_fire_elementals.comple: The flames are weaker. The elders say the oasis spring remembers the kingdom. Perhaps it can tell you where the fire comes from.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_oasis.offer: The oasis is a tear the desert keeps hidden. Once it was the queen's garden. It lies among the northern dunes. Find it, and listen to what the spring says.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_oasis.complete: You slept half a day by the spring, and woke with fire still in your eyes. Tell me what you saw.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_sandworms.offer: The heat below drove the sandworms to the surface, and a whole caravan vanished. Kill eight and open a road to the rift, for us and for you.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_sandworms.complete: The sand lies still. Only the rift in the far south remains, and Helia who guards it: the queen's sacred bird.
strings.data.quest.q_seal_fire_rift.offer: Helia guards the rift and rises again from her own ashes. Don't hate her; the fire has bound her. Set her free, and let her new flame close the rift.
strings.data.quest.q_seal_fire_rift.complete: The rift is closed, and tonight the wind is cool. Four fires burn in your hand now... you know where the last one is.
strings.data.quest.q_scorpion_venom.offer: Every dead caravan bears the same purple-black blossoms: the mark of Syss. The mother of scorpions dwells in the eastern valley. Cut out her venom sac. Venom kills, and venom heals.
strings.data.quest.q_scorpion_venom.complete: The sac still pulses. So it is in the desert: the deadlier, the more precious. Tonight I brew the antidote, and the caravans ride again.
strings.data.quest.q_escort_survivor_desert.offe: A wounded explorer lies in Scorpion Valley; he won't last another sunset. Lead him through to the oasis camp. The scorpions and flames will show no mercy.
strings.data.quest.q_escort_survivor_desert.comp: He lives. The desert swallowed one fewer today, thanks to you.
strings.data.quest.q_craft_fire_ward.offer: I need a fire ward against the sun. Take three purified waterskins and three venoms to the desert merchant, have it made, and bring it to me.
strings.data.quest.q_craft_fire_ward.complete: The ward is cool as well water. With it, I can walk into the Fire Wastes. Thank you, friend.
strings.data.quest.q_buried_treasure.offer: Look at this tablet! Ancient script, whole sentences, and it's shattered, the pieces scattered in the sand around the ruins. Help me find them all and take them to the nomad chief. He's the only one who can still read it!
strings.data.quest.q_buried_treasure.complete: The nomad read it aloud: the Sun Queen's last decree, "Return the fire to its hearth." ...Where have I heard that before? This tablet was worth ten more years of digging!
strings.data.quest.q_water_supply.offer: My rod won't stop trembling over the western sands. There's a spring below. Follow the rod to three patches of damp sand; the spring is at the last. Only... something else is breathing beneath the sound of the water.
strings.data.quest.q_water_supply.complete: The Spring-Eater is dead and the water rises. I can hear it laughing. Tonight the children won't have to lick the dew.
strings.data.quest.q_mirage_beasts.offer: The two flames in the northern haze are no illusion. They are bonded fire spirits, one of day and one of night, never apart. Walk into the mirage and put them out together.
strings.data.quest.q_mirage_beasts.complete: The haze holds no flames now. The travelers they lured away won't return... but no one else will be lured.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_abyss.offer: Brand-bearer... the wardens have waited a thousand years for you. The rift entrance, the Demon Spire, the Throne of Chaos: go learn the enemy's ground. It counts only if you return.
strings.data.quest.q_explore_abyss.complete: You came back. Few do. Your face tells me you've already seen the gate.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_demons.offer: Every inch the gate widens, another horde pours through. Twenty imps, ten lesser demons. The numbers don't matter. Let none of them cross the rift.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_demons.complete: They fell back a step. Only a step. To forge the Final Key, we need their own essence as the binding.
strings.data.quest.q_collect_demon_essence.offer: Lock the fire's gate with things of the fire: that was Aethelyn's way. Imps, lesser demons, succubi all carry essence. Fifteen. Go.
strings.data.quest.q_collect_demon_essence.compl: Enough essence. Last of all, the seal fragments the wardens paid for with their lives must be forged into a key.
strings.data.quest.q_forge_seal.offer: The fragments lie near the Heroes' Memorial, and each one cost a comrade's life. Bring back five, and forge the Final Key with the Hammer you carry.
strings.data.quest.q_forge_seal.complete: The key is made. But it still lacks one thing... you already know, don't you?
strings.data.quest.q_kill_abyss_lord.offer: He sits on the Throne of Chaos, waiting for you, and for your fire. Take the key and go. The wardens have waited a thousand years. Don't let it be for nothing.
strings.data.quest.q_kill_abyss_lord.complete: The gate is closed. The Abyssfire isn't out; it has gone back to the hearth. Go home, Flamekeeper.
strings.data.quest.q_demon_weaponry.offer: Every demon blade comes from the armory camp to the south, kept by Quartermaster Morax. Kill him and bring me his war sigil. If we can read their orders, we can move first.
strings.data.quest.q_demon_weaponry.complete: The orders on this sigil... they mean to strike the seal stone. Good. Now we know where they'll come from.
strings.data.quest.q_defend_seal_abyss.offer: The demon legion is assaulting the seal stone. Five waves. If it breaks, the abyss spreads again. Hold. Do not fall back.
strings.data.quest.q_defend_seal_abyss.complete: The seal stone stands. So do you. That's enough.
strings.data.quest.q_corrupted_souls.offer: Karon, Lyss, Gig... my three soldiers, who swore themselves to the demons. I taught them to hold a sword, but not to hold an oath. I cannot raise my hand against them... please, end it for me.
strings.data.quest.q_corrupted_souls.complete: All three... gone. Did they say anything at the end? ...No. Don't tell me. The oaths they broke are mine to carry now.
strings.data.quest.q_fallen_hero.offer: Half a last testament is carved at the shrine, half on the memorial, left by those who sealed the abyss three hundred years ago. I can't read them... the letters burn before my eyes. Take rubbings and bring them to the warden.
strings.data.quest.q_fallen_hero.complete: The warden read it to me: "make a hearth of the heart." ...So they knew, all along. Perhaps I'm still fit to hold a sword.
strings.data.quest.q_void_crystals.offer: Crystals that breathe, growing on the rift's edge! With every breath, space wrinkles. Harvest five before they grow into the next tear, and bring them back alive!
strings.data.quest.q_void_crystals.complete: Look, still breathing! Perfectly in step with the rift... I'd wager the gate's own heartbeat is in here. Leave the rest to me.
strings.data.quest.q_pet_owl.offer: The night the Moon Seal broke, my old friend Moonwing fled in fright. Its feathers catch the moonlight. Follow them, and you'll likely find it in some hollow tree.
strings.data.quest.q_pet_owl.complete: That's him! Still glaring at everything. He has chosen you. Go on, take him along.
strings.data.quest.q_pet_cat.offer: The dead dragged a cat's shadow in between life and death, and it cries in my ear every night. Take back its shadow shards, then defeat the Shade Binder who keeps it.
strings.data.quest.q_pet_cat.complete: The shadow is whole again, and it won't go back to the dark. It only follows you. Let it.
strings.data.quest.q_pet_dragon.offer: With the usurper gone, a warm dragon egg rolled out from under the old forge! It needs fresh fire to hatch. Take three forge embers from the stone golems' hearts and feed them to the blacksmith's furnace.
strings.data.quest.q_pet_dragon.complete: The fire roared and the shell cracked! Look at the little one, sneezing sparks already. It's yours.
strings.story.prologue.1.title: Abyssfire
strings.story.prologue.1.text: The world was forged in the fire at the bottom of the Abyss. Six keepers swore to tend it: to let it warm, and never burn.
strings.story.prologue.2.title: The Burned Oath
strings.story.prologue.2.text: The brightest of the six feared most that the fire would go out. He burned his oath to throw the world back into the fire and recast it. The other five made locks of their lives, bound him in the deep under five seals, and chiselled away his name.
strings.story.prologue.3.title: The Whisper
strings.story.prologue.3.text: For a thousand years he could only speak. In the dark he looked for people who feared the end, and promised them a fire that would never go out.
strings.story.prologue.4.title: The Ashen Crusade
strings.story.prologue.4.text: This autumn the Church of the Kept Flame heard "the Flame's call", and the Ashen Crusade marched to the eastern border. Before the last battle Lord-Marshal Valdras gave his order: hold the Red Field. Not one step back.
strings.story.prologue.5.title: The Breach
strings.story.prologue.5.text: Too much blood was spilled. The old seal beneath the Red Field cracked: black blood and worse welled out of the Breach. The slain did not lie down. They are still obeying their last order.
strings.story.prologue.6.title: Woken in Ash
strings.story.prologue.6.text: You wake in the burn pit outside Knellwatch, ash above you and ash below. On your palm is a brand: five flames around an empty heart. Above the lip of the pit, a bell is tolling.
strings.story.chapter.emerald_plains.title: Woken from Ash
strings.story.chapter.emerald_plains.subtitle: The Red Field
strings.story.chapter.emerald_plains.text: The dead do not sleep. In a beaten army's last fort, every dusk, the bell tolls once for every new name.
strings.story.chapter.twilight_forest.title: The Erased Name
strings.story.chapter.twilight_forest.subtitle: The Twilight Forest
strings.story.chapter.twilight_forest.text:
No moonlight has touched this ground in centuries, and the dead walk the woods.
A history someone chose to forget waits for you in the deepest shade.
strings.story.chapter.anvil_mountains.title: The Hammer of Fate
strings.story.chapter.anvil_mountains.subtitle: The Anvil Mountains
strings.story.chapter.anvil_mountains.text:
The dwarven forges have been cold for a hundred years.
Deep in the mountain, the hammer that forged the five seals waits for a hand to wake it.
strings.story.chapter.scorching_desert.title: Embers of the Sun Crown
strings.story.chapter.scorching_desert.subtitle: The Scorching Desert
strings.story.chapter.scorching_desert.text:
A kingdom burned to glass in a single night, and its sacred bird still cries out in the flames.
The sands remember everything, even the betrayal.
strings.story.chapter.abyss_rift.title: Abyssfire
strings.story.chapter.abyss_rift.subtitle: The Abyss Rift
strings.story.chapter.abyss_rift.text:
The fires of five lands all flow here.
The one behind the gate has waited a thousand years for you, and the emptiness in your palm will at last be filled.
strings.story.boss.werewolf_alpha.name: Volgan
strings.story.boss.mountain_troll.name: Gorm
strings.story.boss.phoenix.name: Helia
strings.story.boss.demon_lord.name: Ignaroth
strings.story.boss.dungeon_abyss_lord.name: Kassanor
strings.story.boss.dungeon_abyss_lord.epithet: Lord of the Abyss, Prisoner-King of the Labyrinth
strings.story.cs_boss_kassanor.1: At the labyrinth's heart, shattered memories settle into a black sea. Beneath its surface, something opens its eyes.
strings.story.cs_boss_kassanor.2: Ignaroth has fallen? Good. His throne stands empty, and this labyrinth has but one master now.
strings.story.cs_boss_kassanor.3: Every memory down here whispers to the fire you carry. Give it to me, and I will let you walk back into the sun.
strings.story.cs_boss_kassanor.4: All you guard is someone else's broken dream.
strings.story.cs_boss_kassanor.5: Then drown in it with me!
strings.story.cs_tf_hermit.1: The campfire crackles, but you can still hear the hermit's rasping voice...
strings.story.cs_tf_hermit.3: Five sages? That's a lie the living tell, child. Six swore to keep the flame.
strings.story.cs_tf_hermit.4: The sixth was Ignaroth, the Flamekeeper, brightest of them all. When the ley lines cooled, he was the first to panic.
strings.story.cs_tf_hermit.5: He said the world was a flawed casting, fit only for the furnace. So he burned his oath and opened the Abyss.
strings.story.cs_tf_hermit.6: The five paid with their lives to lock him in the deep, and chiselled out his name. But locks rust, and he is patient.
strings.story.cs_tf_hermit.7: The sorcerer who fused himself with the Tree of Life was listening to his whispers. The Moon Seal broke, and the sun never returned.
strings.story.cs_tf_hermit.8: That emptiness in your palm was his seat. The Heartflame Aethelyn hid has chosen you.
strings.story.cs_tf_hermit.10: The old man leaves things out. The Heartflame was always mine. And you will come back to me in the end.
strings.story.cs_tf_hermit.12: ...I don't follow old stories. I know the wolf king guards the road to the dark source. It goes first.
strings.story.cs_tf_finale.2: You press the brand into the dark source. Between the rotting roots, a silver light slowly rises.
strings.story.cs_tf_finale.4: For the first time in centuries, moonlight pierces the gloom and falls on the forest floor.
strings.story.cs_tf_finale.5: The second flame of the brand lights up, frost-white, carrying a sigh from Selenne the Moon Priestess.
strings.story.cs_tf_finale.7: Do you hear it...? The dead are thanking you. At last they can sleep.
strings.story.cs_tf_finale.9: The Moon Seal burns again. A letter just came from the dwarves: something is stirring beneath the Anvil Mountains.
strings.story.cs_tf_finale.10: Two lamps. You walk so quickly. Faster than she ever did.
strings.story.cs_tf_finale.11: You say nothing. You close your burning hand and walk toward the mountains in the east.
strings.story.cs_tf_finale.12: The forest hermit takes up his staff. He will keep a moon well beneath the elven tower, a resting place for stray ley-beasts.
strings.story.cs_am_hammer.2: Mithril cores, our ancestors' runes, King Bruun's hammerhead... all here! Step up to the forge, brand-bearer.
strings.story.cs_am_hammer.3: The forge, cold for a hundred years, bursts into flame the moment you draw near.
strings.story.cs_am_hammer.6: The fire knows you! King Bruun forged this hammer from embers of the Abyssfire, then forged the five seals with it.
strings.story.cs_am_hammer.7.title: The Hammer of Fate
strings.story.cs_am_hammer.7.subtitle: Relic of King Bruun
strings.story.cs_am_hammer.8: The hammer rises and falls in a rain of sparks. On the ninth blow, its runes and your brand flare as one.
strings.story.cs_am_hammer.9: It's yours now. Remember: a hammer that forges seals can forge keys. One day you'll need that.
strings.story.cs_am_hammer.10: Bruun's hammer... he used it to nail my locks shut. How lovely. Now it is in your hands.
strings.story.cs_am_hammer.11: Why so pale? Hmph. Whatever is talking to you, first knock that troll off our throne!
strings.story.cs_am_finale.2: The troll's body rolls from the throne, revealing an ancient anvil carved with runes beneath it.
strings.story.cs_am_finale.3: You raise the Hammer of Fate and strike. The anvil rings out, and the whole mountain answers.
strings.story.cs_am_finale.6: The third flame of the brand lights up, red as molten iron and steady as stone.
strings.story.cs_am_finale.8: The anvil sings again! A hundred years... By my ancestors, these old bones lived to hear it!
strings.story.cs_am_finale.9: But know this, child: the fourth seal, in the southern desert, broke first and worst. Someone smashed it by hand.
strings.story.cs_am_finale.10: Three. Do you know why the high priest broke his seal? Because I promised him forever.
strings.story.cs_am_finale.11: I always keep my word. Go and see how eternal he is now.
strings.story.cs_am_finale.12: On the southern horizon, a column of smoke climbs into the sky.
strings.story.cs_am_finale.13: The dwarf elder picks out a small forge and sends an artisan over the mountains to the Ember Tower: a flamekeeper's home needs a proper hearth.
strings.story.cs_sd_oasis.2: The spring shows you the desert of a thousand years ago. No: a kingdom.
strings.story.cs_sd_oasis.4.title: The Sun Crown Kingdom
strings.story.cs_sd_oasis.4.subtitle: A Thousand Years Ago
strings.story.cs_sd_oasis.5: Spires everywhere, streams like woven silk. Queen Nafsha stands on the high terrace, the sunbird Helia burning gold upon her shoulder.
strings.story.cs_sd_oasis.6: When the queen gave herself to the seal, her high priest took up its watch. He kept it until his hair turned white, and learned to fear death.
strings.story.cs_sd_oasis.7: Then you hear a familiar voice, a thousand years ago, speaking to him:
strings.story.cs_sd_oasis.8: You need not die. Open it, and you will live as long as the fire.
strings.story.cs_sd_oasis.10: The high priest shattered the Sun Seal. That night fire burst from the earth, and the kingdom became ash.
strings.story.cs_sd_oasis.11: Helia was chained by the Abyssfire, to burn for the rift forever. The high priest got his eternity: an undying wraith in the sand.
strings.story.cs_sd_oasis.13: What you saw was our ancestors' kingdom. We nomads are only what that fire left behind.
strings.story.cs_sd_oasis.14: Helia is no monster. Set her free, brand-bearer. When she is free, the fire can go home.
strings.story.cs_sd_finale.2: Helia's body crumbles to ash in the blaze. After a moment of silence, a clear cry rings out from the ashes.
strings.story.cs_sd_finale.4: The reborn sunbird takes wing, and its golden fire sweeps across the rift, stitching it shut inch by inch.
strings.story.cs_sd_finale.5: The fourth flame of the brand lights up, golden as the noonday sun.
strings.story.cs_sd_finale.7: The wind is cool tonight... Ancestors, do you see?
strings.story.cs_sd_finale.8: But every fire under the sand is flowing to one place: the Abyss Rift. The one behind the gate is awake.
strings.story.cs_sd_finale.9: Four lamps. Enough. Come, child. Come to the gate, and bring the last one with you.
strings.story.cs_sd_finale.11: Four flames burn on the brand. For the first time, the empty heart of it aches.
strings.story.cs_sd_finale.12: The nomads' camel bells turn west. From now on, a caravan post stands beneath the Ember Tower.
strings.story.cs_ar_gate.2: You heard it too, didn't you? The voice behind the gate. Wardens have listened for a thousand years, and listening, stopped being themselves.
strings.story.cs_ar_gate.4.title: The Throne of Chaos
strings.story.cs_ar_gate.4.subtitle: Gate of the Abyssfire
strings.story.cs_ar_gate.5: Behind the throne stands a vast gate bound by five runes. Four burn anew. The last one gutters in the wind.
strings.story.cs_ar_gate.6: At last you've come. Look at your hand: four lamps lit, and one about to go out.
strings.story.cs_ar_gate.7: You thought you were mending seals? Their souls are the locks, and the keys. What you gathered on the road is the key to this gate.
strings.story.cs_ar_gate.10: The brand sears. Its four flames lean toward the gate, as if something were pulling them.
strings.story.cs_ar_gate.11: I am Ignaroth, the sixth sage. The emptiness in your palm is my seat.
strings.story.cs_ar_gate.13: The one who opens is the one who closes. The stele was right. The key is in your hand. Which way the gate swings is yours to choose.
strings.story.cs_ar_seal.2: The fragments are all here. Give me the Hammer. No, you forge it. It answers only to the brand-bearer's hand.
strings.story.cs_ar_seal.3: The hammer rises and falls. Five seal fragments melt together in the violet fire of the Abyss and become a key of dark silver.
strings.story.cs_ar_seal.5.title: The Final Key
strings.story.cs_ar_seal.5.subtitle: Five Souls Lock, One Heart Turns
strings.story.cs_ar_seal.6: The fifth flame of the brand lights up, dark silver as night: the last light left by Aethelyn the Warden.
strings.story.cs_ar_seal.7: Five flames can open the gate or lock it. But to shut it forever, the key needs a heart: the Heartflame.
strings.story.cs_ar_seal.8: Aethelyn was the first of my line, and his own sister. Her words were: when the Heartflame returns to the deep, its bearer goes with the fire.
strings.story.cs_ar_seal.10: You look down at your palm. Beneath the emptiness, something has been beating all along: warm, quiet, like a heart.
strings.story.cs_ar_seal.12: You will give it to me. Everyone does, in the end.
strings.story.cs_ar_seal.13: The wardens waited a thousand years for someone willing to go. Go, child. May the Abyssfire light your way home.
strings.story.cs_ar_fall.4: The Abyssfire incarnate shatters. When the flames fall away, only an old man remains before the throne.
strings.story.cs_ar_fall.5: ...A thousand years. I only wanted to keep it from going out. The veins were cooling, the world was dying. Could none of you see?
strings.story.cs_ar_fall.7: You raise your palm. The five flames light one by one, and in the empty heart the Heartflame takes shape at last.
strings.story.cs_ar_fall.8: Aethelyn... so this is where you hid it. Always the same. You would rather give the fire away.
strings.story.cs_ar_fall.9: You set the Final Key in the gate and return the Heartflame to the Abyssfire. Not to him. To the world.
strings.story.cs_ar_fall.11: The fire does not devour you. It settles like embers in a hearth and sends its warmth along the ley lines to all five lands.
strings.story.cs_ar_fall.12: It is... rekindling. Without burning everything... it rekindles. So she was right all along.
strings.story.cs_ar_fall.13: Ignaroth crumbles into a wisp of ash and is carried off on the wind. Without a sound, the great gate closes.
strings.story.cs_ar_fall.14: The five flames on your palm fade into a ring of silver. At its centre remains one small, warm light.
strings.story.cs_boss_werewolf_alpha.2: A howl tears the night apart. The moon died long ago, yet it still howls at the sky.
strings.story.cs_boss_werewolf_alpha.4: Grrh... the moon... no longer answers. Now only that voice... answers me.
strings.story.cs_boss_werewolf_alpha.5: Selenne's sacred wolf, her most loyal guardian. Loyalty is a fine thing. You need only change the master.
strings.story.cs_boss_mountain_troll.3: Little thing! This chair is Gorm's! There's fire singing under the chair, and it sings only for Gorm!
strings.story.cs_boss_mountain_troll.5: A troll's head holds very little. Just enough room for me.
strings.story.cs_boss_phoenix.2: Heat bends the air. A burning bird rises from the rift, and every beat of its wings rains fire.
strings.story.cs_boss_phoenix.4: Look at her. Queen Nafsha's beloved bird, and now she burns only for me.
strings.story.cs_boss_phoenix.5: The sunbird lets out a piercing cry, full of rage, and of pleading.
strings.story.cs_boss_demon_lord.2: Upon the Throne of Chaos, the Abyssfire gathers into a colossal form. A thousand years of whispers finally have a face.
strings.story.cs_boss_demon_lord.4: You brought all five lamps, and the Heartflame she hid. Good. Today, everything goes back into the forge.
strings.story.cs_boss_demon_lord.5: I will forge a world that never goes out. No cold, no death. No one forgotten, ever again.
strings.story.cs_boss_demon_lord.7: Then let the fire judge us, heir of the Flamekeeper!
strings.story.epilogue.1.heading: Epilogue
strings.story.epilogue.1.title: The Gate Is Closed
strings.story.epilogue.1.text:
The moment the gate closed, all five lands felt a sudden warmth.
Not a blaze. More like someone adding wood to the hearth on a winter night.
strings.story.epilogue.2.title: The Red Field
strings.story.epilogue.2.text:
The dead of the Red Field have lain down and not risen again.
On Knellwatch's Name Wall, a new row of names. At dusk the bell still tolls once for each.
strings.story.epilogue.3.title: Forest and Mountain
strings.story.epilogue.3.text:
The Twilight Forest greets its first morning in centuries; the dead sleep, and wolves sing to the moon again.
In the Anvil Mountains the forges burn day and night, and the dwarves have come home to their halls.
strings.story.epilogue.4.title: Sand and Abyss
strings.story.epilogue.4.text:
Helia circles above the oasis, and one by one the dry springs run clear.
The Abyss Rift slowly cools, and the wardens lay down a burden they carried for a thousand years.
strings.story.epilogue.5.title: The Flamekeeper
strings.story.epilogue.5.text:
You lived. The brand on your palm faded to a ring of silver,
with one small light at its heart: the fire's thanks, and a new oath.
People have begun to call you the Flamekeeper.
strings.story.epilogue.6.title: Abyssfire
strings.story.epilogue.6.text:
The Abyssfire never went out.
It only returned to the hearth, to warm a world that is flawed, and worth keeping.

strings.story.credits.1.text: A tale of fire, oaths, and the road home

strings.story.credits.3.heading: Technology

strings.story.credits.4.text: Every Flamekeeper who made it this far
strings.story.credits.5.title: Thank You for Playing
strings.story.credits.6.text:
Beneath the Abyss lies a deeper dark.
Nightmare difficulty awaits.
strings.story.cs_tf_moonfang.2: The wolf king falls, and the Abyssfire in its eyes gutters out. For the first time in a thousand years, it is still.
strings.story.cs_tf_moonfang.3: From the ferns beside the body creeps a silver-grey cub, a white crescent on its brow.
strings.story.cs_tf_moonfang.4.title: Moonfang
strings.story.cs_tf_moonfang.4.subtitle: Son of Volgan
strings.story.cs_tf_moonfang.5: It sniffs the brand on your palm, and does not run.
strings.story.cs_tf_moonfang.7: The cub gives a low whine and falls in at your heel.
strings.story.cs_sd_helia.2: The light of the rebirth fades, but a small ember lingers on the sand and will not go out.
strings.story.cs_sd_helia.4: A chick peeks out of the ember, its feather tips burning red-gold, and looks up at you shyly.
strings.story.cs_sd_helia.5.title: Helia's Ember
strings.story.cs_sd_helia.5.subtitle: The sunbird's last fire
strings.story.cs_sd_helia.7: The sunbird left its last spark to you. The old ones say a chick like that chooses one person for life.
strings.story.cs_sd_helia.8: The chick flutters onto your shoulder. Its warmth seeps through your clothes, all the way to your palm.
strings.story.cs_ar_altar.2: The essence of the abyss is mine to keep now. It was fire once, and it will return to fire.
strings.story.cs_ar_altar.3: I cannot guard the Heartflame for you. But its warmth, that I can keep.
strings.story.cs_ar_altar.4: The warden hands her silver lamp to a messenger, bound for the Ember Tower, to light the altar that has lain cold for a thousand years.
strings.story.cs_ar_altar.5: Offer embers when you are home, and the altar will guard you for a while. It is all Aethelyn's blood can give you.
strings.story.cs_tower_home.2.title: The Ember Tower
strings.story.cs_tower_home.2.subtitle: The Flamekeeper's hearth
strings.story.cs_tower_home.3: You woke in these ashes. Back then the tower lay broken: scorched steps and cold grey ash.
strings.story.cs_tower_home.5: You're back, child. This old man came ahead to warm the place up for everyone.
strings.story.cs_tower_home.6: This place was ashes once. Now it is your home.
strings.story.cs_tower_home.7: Every seal you light, someone will follow the glow here and restore a wing.
strings.story.cs_tower_home.8: Beneath the tower, the ley lines' warmth stirs, as if in answer.

strings.data.quest.q_pet_owl.name: Moon Owl
strings.data.quest.q_pet_owl.desc: The night the Moon Seal broke, the hermit's owl of thirty years, Moonwing, fled in fright. Follow the silver-lit feathers through the woods to the hollow tree where it hides.
strings.data.quest.q_pet_cat.name: Shadow Cat
strings.data.quest.q_pet_cat.desc: The spirit medium says a cat's shadow was dragged between life and death by the dead. Take its shadow shards back from the wandering dead, then defeat the Shade Binder who keeps it.
strings.data.quest.q_pet_dragon.name: Magma Hatchling
strings.data.quest.q_pet_dragon.desc: With the usurper fallen, a warm dragon egg rolled out from under the old king's forge. The dwarf elder says it needs fresh fire: forge embers from the hearts of the mountain's stone golems.
strings.data.questClue.clue_owl_hollow: A low "hoo" from the hollow. Moonwing huddles inside, moonlight on its feathers.
strings.data.pet.pet_sprite.name: Lanternwisp
strings.data.pet.pet_sprite.desc: Pell's lantern. The youngest of the burial detail is gone; his light still walks from grave to grave.
strings.data.pet.pet_owl.name: Moon Owl
strings.data.pet.pet_owl.desc: The forest hermit's old friend. Its gaze lays bare an enemy's weak spot.
strings.data.pet.pet_owl.origin: Chapter 2 · The forest hermit's side quest
strings.data.pet.pet_storm_wolf.name: Crescent
strings.data.pet.pet_storm_wolf.desc: Son of Volgan. When his father fell, he followed the heartflame to you.
strings.data.pet.pet_cat.name: Shade Cat
strings.data.pet.pet_cat.desc: The spirit-medium's shadow. It always bites from behind.
strings.data.pet.pet_jade_tortoise.name: Xuanwu
strings.data.pet.pet_jade_tortoise.desc: An ancient guardian with mountain ridges carved into its shell.
strings.data.pet.pet_dragon.name: Magma Whelp
strings.data.pet.pet_dragon.desc: Hatched in the dwarf elder's forge. Its first breath cost him his beard.
strings.data.pet.pet_dragon.origin: Chapter 3 · The dwarf elder's side quest
strings.data.pet.pet_phoenix.name: Helia's Ember
strings.data.pet.pet_phoenix.desc: The chick Helia left in her ashes. The fire was given back, so it burns for you.
strings.data.pet.pet_phoenix.origin: Chapter 4 · After the Corona Seal is rekindled
strings.data.pet.pet_void_butterfly.name: Void Butterfly
strings.data.pet.pet_void_butterfly.desc: It fluttered out of a crack in the rift, wings full of starlight from elsewhere.
strings.data.pet.ability.sprite_heal_pulse.name: Healing Pulse
strings.data.pet.ability.sprite_heal_pulse.desc: When the hero's life runs low, restores 8% of their max life.

strings.data.pet.ability.sprite_ley_ward.desc: When the hero is surrounded, raises a ward: 20% less damage taken for 5s.
strings.data.pet.ability.owl_moon_mark.name: Moonmark
strings.data.pet.ability.owl_moon_mark.desc: Marks the target for 6s. Marked enemies take 15% more damage.
strings.data.pet.ability.owl_talon_dive.name: Talon Dive
strings.data.pet.ability.owl_talon_dive.desc: Dives from above for 220% attack damage.
strings.data.pet.ability.wolf_pounce.name: Pounce
strings.data.pet.ability.wolf_pounce.desc: Leaps at a distant enemy for 150% damage and makes it bleed for 4s.
strings.data.pet.ability.wolf_moon_howl.name: Moon Howl
strings.data.pet.ability.wolf_moon_howl.desc: The hero deals 15% more damage for 6s.
strings.data.pet.ability.cat_backstab.name: Backstab
strings.data.pet.ability.cat_backstab.desc: Slips behind the target: a guaranteed critical hit for 220% damage.
strings.data.pet.ability.cat_shadow_flurry.name: Shadow Flurry

strings.data.pet.ability.tortoise_taunt.desc: Nearby enemies turn on Xuanwu for 5s, and the hero is shielded (25% less damage taken).
strings.data.pet.ability.tortoise_quake.name: Mountain Stomp
strings.data.pet.ability.tortoise_quake.desc: Stamps the ground: 100% damage to nearby enemies and a 1.2s stun.
strings.data.pet.ability.dragon_fire_breath.name: Fire Breath
strings.data.pet.ability.dragon_fire_breath.desc: Breathes fire in a cone ahead: 130% fire damage and a burn.
strings.data.pet.ability.dragon_magma_orb.name: Magma Orb
strings.data.pet.ability.dragon_magma_orb.desc: Spits a molten orb for 200% fire damage that splashes around.
strings.data.pet.ability.phoenix_ember_mend.name: Ember Mend

strings.data.pet.ability.phoenix_rekindle.desc: Passive: when the hero falls, they rise again at 40% life. Once per zone.

strings.data.pet.ability.phoenix_flame_ring.desc: A ring of fire around the target: 120% fire damage and a burn.

strings.data.pet.ability.butterfly_void_rift.des: Tears a rift at the target: 110% damage and a 35% slow.

It's nearly dark. They have to get home. You're in the way.
strings.story.boss.valdras.name: Lord-Marshal Valdras
strings.story.boss.valdras.epithet: The Banner That Will Not Fall
strings.story.cs_boss_valdras.4: I gave the order: not one step back. I am still carrying it out.
strings.story.cs_boss_valdras.5: He held well, child. Pity it was my door he held.
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_01.name: The Marshal's Last Order
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_01.text: The whole army holds the Red Field. Whoever takes one step back is a traitor, executed where he stands. — Valdras
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_02.name: A Deserter's Journal
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_02.text: Three days before the battle the Marshal had us dig pits. Many. I asked who for. The sergeant said: for whoever won't hold.
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_03.name: Shard of the Seal
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_03.text: A shard of stone, warm as if someone had just held it. Its lines match the brand on your palm.
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_04.name: The Catechism Stone
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_04.text: Q: Why must the Flame be kept? A: Because the world grows cold, and people are forgotten.
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_echo_01.name: The Seventh Man
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_echo_01.text: A shade with a lantern kneels by the trench; the lantern has gone out: "Tell Serin... I'm the one who lost the lantern."
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_echo_02.name: The Far Bank
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_echo_02.text: A family's shades sit at the burned bridge: "The bridge is on fire. We'll wait on this side... until she comes back."
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_echo_03.name: By the Dais
strings.data.lore.lore_rf_echo_03.text: A kneeling shade, hands still bound behind: "I only wanted to go home and farm."
strings.data.hiddenArea.hidden_rf_paymaster.name: The Paymaster's Wagon
strings.data.hiddenArea.hidden_rf_paymaster.disc: The driver is still chained to the strongbox. No one came to save him, or for the money.
strings.data.storyDeco.story_rf_belfry.name: Ashwheat's Broken Belfry
strings.data.storyDeco.story_rf_belfry.desc: Ashwheat's bell lies split in the mud. Its clapper is gone.
strings.data.storyDeco.story_rf_red_banner.name: The Red Banner
strings.data.storyDeco.story_rf_red_banner.desc: A red banner planted in a mound of shields. Every shield faces Knellwatch.
The basin's groove runs downhill toward the Breach. Ash has settled in it, and something dried black.
strings.data.subDungeonSealed.entrance_rf_pit: The pit mouth is still smoking. Wait for the fire to die.
strings.data.npc.knell_chaplain.name: Brother Aldwin
strings.data.npc.knell_chaplain.dialogue.0: The bell is for the living. The dead... someone else is talking to them.
strings.data.npc.knell_chaplain.dialogue.1: I say a prayer for every name. By the three hundredth I began to fear I'd forget who it was for.
strings.data.npc.crow_trader.name: Mag Crowe
strings.data.npc.crow_trader.dialogue.0: Don't ask whose boots. Ask the price.
strings.data.escortNpc.rf_hallowed_ground.line: Twelve to a cart, all named. I read each one to the earth.
strings.data.achievement.ach_kill_valdras.name: The Order to Retreat
strings.data.achievement.ach_kill_valdras.title: The Order to Retreat
strings.sys.event.msg.ambush.emerald_plains: Far off, the bell tolls once. Hands come up out of the mud.
strings.sys.event.msg.treasure_cache.emerald_pla: An iron strongbox lies half-sunk in the mud. The knight who owned it has no more use for it.
strings.sys.event.msg.wandering_merchant.emerald: By the road someone has laid out a tray of relics on an old cloth.
strings.sys.event.msg.rescue.emerald_plains: A pilgrim is tied to a stake. The Red-Oath are watching him.
strings.sys.event.msg.environmental_puzzle.emera: Five handbells hang from a broken post.
strings.zone.event.merchant.announce.emerald_pla: The Relic Peddler: "Saint's bones, genuine. At least one of them is."
strings.zone.event.rescue.complete.emerald_plain: You cut the pilgrim loose. "They said I walked too slowly to keep up with the Flame." Gained {gold} gold and {exp} EXP
strings.data.quest.q_rf_burial_detail.name: The Burial Detail
strings.data.quest.q_rf_burial_detail.desc: Ten men of the burial detail went out at dusk and never came back. Go north to the trenches and put down whoever is standing.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_burial_detail.offer: The burial detail went out at dusk with one lantern. An hour ago the lantern stopped moving. Go north to the trenches. If they're standing... don't hesitate.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_burial_detail.progress: The lantern's still in the trench. Not one of them came back.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_burial_detail.complete: Ten men. My brother was the seventh. ...Go to the chaplain. He wants to see your hand.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_gnawed_field.name: The Gnawed Field
strings.data.quest.q_rf_gnawed_field.desc: In the wheat below the walls, gravegnawers are eating the rearguard. Kill twelve, then find the thing that rings them to supper.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_gnawed_field.offer: The rearguard died in the wheat below our walls. Now something is eating them. What gets eaten can never be buried.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_gnawed_field.progress: Do you hear that bell? It isn't ours.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_gnawed_field.complete: That clapper is from Ashwheat's bell. It rang every night. It was calling them to supper.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_ashwheat.name: Ashwheat
strings.data.quest.q_rf_ashwheat.desc: There are lights in Ashwheat, and no one should be left there. Go and look, then follow the wagon ruts to whoever led the villagers away.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_ashwheat.offer: Scouts saw lights in Ashwheat. There shouldn't be anyone left there. Go and see who lit them, and where the villagers were led.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_ashwheat.progress: Ashwheat... you'll understand when you get there.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_ashwheat.complete: I burned the bridge. They were calling from the far bank. I heard them. I burned it anyway.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_marshal.name: The Sleepless Marshal
strings.data.quest.q_rf_marshal.desc: Lord-Marshal Valdras still holds the edge of the Breach, carrying out his last order. Go and tell him the war is over.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_marshal.offer: I ordered the retreat and brought back two hundred. He ordered us to hold, and three thousand died. He's still holding, at the edge of the Breach. Go and tell him the war is over.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_marshal.progress: He won't fall back. Don't you either.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_marshal.complete: He asked who gave the order? ...You should have told him. It was me.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_last_toll.name: The Last Toll
strings.data.quest.q_rf_last_toll.desc: The Marshal is down. Tonight every dead man on the Red Field walks toward Knellwatch. Hold the Boneyard Gate until dawn.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_last_toll.offer: The Marshal is down and the Breach is gasping. Tonight every dead man on the Red Field walks this way. Go to the Boneyard Gate and hold it till dawn.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_last_toll.progress: The gate still stands? Then hold a little longer. It's nearly dawn.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_last_toll.complete: Dawn, and the bell still hangs. ...Someone should take the east road now.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_black_blood.name: Black Blood
strings.data.quest.q_rf_black_blood.desc: Marl needs six clots of breach-blood, still warm. Take them from the clots in the Seep, never bare-handed, and bring them to her dressing station.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_black_blood.offer: Marl keeps a dressing station outside the walls. The wounded who touch breach-blood turn grey and stop crying out. She needs six clots, still warm.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_black_blood.progress: Don't touch it bare-handed. Marl will show you.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_black_blood.complete: Marl says the blood has voices in it. ...Don't ask me whose.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_barrowmoss.name: Barrowmoss
strings.data.quest.q_rf_barrowmoss.desc: The old rite says barrowmoss burned over a grave makes the dead sleep deeper. Pull five handfuls by the trenches, roots and all.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_barrowmoss.offer: The old rite says: burn barrowmoss over a grave and the dead sleep deeper. Some grows by the trenches. Bring five handfuls, before they wake.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_barrowmoss.progress: Pull it by the root. The ash is in the root; the ash is what holds them down.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_barrowmoss.complete: Smell that? Like ash after rain. Tonight they'll sleep a little better.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_tag_thief.name: The Tag-Thief
strings.data.quest.q_rf_tag_thief.desc: Someone is cutting the name-tags off the dead. Follow his trail and bring the tags back.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_tag_thief.offer: Someone is cutting the name-tags off the dead. Without a tag, the bell doesn't know whom it tolls for. Find him.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_tag_thief.progress: One tag, one name. One tag missing, one toll missing.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_tag_thief.complete: Forty-one names. Hald's youngest is among them. ...The silver is yours to decide.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_oathless.name: Bounty: Harke the Oathless
strings.data.quest.q_rf_oathless.desc: Corran's old sergeant Harke sells pilgrims to the Red-Oath. Corran wants his head, as the price of Knellwatch's gate.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_oathless.offer: Harke was my sergeant. He sells captured pilgrims to the Red-Oath. I want his head. It's my price for Knellwatch's gate.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_oathless.progress: He's in Deserters' Hollow. He knows my face. He doesn't know yours.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_oathless.complete: The head to me, or to the Captain? ...You choose. I'll live with it.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_lanternwisp.name: The Lanternwisp
strings.data.quest.q_rf_lanternwisp.desc: Each night a light walks among the graves of the Weeping Ditch. Follow it and see where it stops.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_lanternwisp.offer: The children say a light walks the Weeping Ditch each night, from grave to grave. See where it stops. Don't follow the wrong light.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_lanternwisp.progress: The true one is warm. The cold ones, keep your hands off.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_lanternwisp.complete: That's Pell's light. The youngest of the burial detail; he carried the lantern. If it wants to follow you, take it.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_hallowed_ground.name: Hallowed Ground
strings.data.quest.q_rf_hallowed_ground.desc: Old Bern is pushing a cart of named dead to the last hallowed ground. Only in the earth by nightfall will they stay down. Guard him.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_hallowed_ground.offer: Bern is taking a cart of the dead to the hallowed ground in the south. If they're not in the earth by nightfall, they'll walk on their own. Guard him.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_hallowed_ground.progress: Every turn of the wheel is a name.
strings.data.quest.q_rf_hallowed_ground.complete: The ground still takes them. ...Perhaps for the last time.
strings.data.questTarget.escort_rf_bern: Escort Bern to the hallowed ground
strings.data.questClue.clue_rf_tag_cord: A cut tag-cord. The cut is fresh.
strings.data.questClue.clue_rf_tag_cloth: A scrap of crusade tabard on the caltrops.
strings.data.questClue.clue_rf_tag_ashes: A banked fire. Melted silver in the ash.
strings.data.questClue.clue_rf_lantern_1: A candle stub on the grave, still warm. Lamp oil drips away east.
strings.data.questClue.clue_rf_lantern_2: Cold lights sway in the ditch. The one at this grave is warm.
strings.data.questClue.clue_rf_lantern_3: Someone has traced the name on the marker again, in ash.
strings.data.questClue.clue_rf_lantern_4: The light stops at this grave and goes no further. As if it were waiting for someone.
strings.data.npc.tower_herbalist.dialogue.0: The fire here asks no one to pay. I keep the garden.
strings.data.npc.tower_herbalist.dialogue.1: Every one you put down out there, the garden grows an inch. Don't ask me why.
strings.data.npc.blacksmith.after.q_rf_tag_thief: I nailed the boy's tag by the forge. I can see it while I work.
strings.data.npc.plains_herbalist.after.q_rf_bla: There are voices in the blood... the dead's. It remembers them.
strings.data.npc.quest_elder.after.q_rf_oathless: A deserter is a deserter. ...So am I.
strings.data.npc.knell_chaplain.after.q_rf_last_: May the bell keep you. ...I will always be listening to it.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_elder.who.text: Serin Harrow, Third Company. Now the highest-ranking living soldier in this fort.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_elder.bell.text: The bell is older than the church; the keepers left it. At dusk, one toll for each name.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_elder.marshal.text: The Marshal ordered us to hold. I ordered the retreat. One of us is a traitor. His crossbowmen are dead and still won't put their bows down.
In the wheat below the walls, something is eating our people.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_elder.accept_gnawers: Twelve of them. And the one ringing the bell.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_elder.other_work.tex: Marl wants blood samples. The chaplain needs hands too. There's a deserter in the southern culvert waiting for someone to listen.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_elder.accept_ichor.t: Don't touch it bare-handed. Marl will show you.
strings.data.dialogue.quest_elder.chaplain_point: Aldwin still prays. I don't know who's still listening.
strings.story.cs_rf_brand.2: Ten went out for the dead. You closed their eyes.
strings.story.cs_rf_brand.3: Ring the bell. Ten times. One for each name.
strings.story.cs_rf_brand.5: The toll rolls slow across the Red Field. Far off, something stops and listens.
strings.story.cs_rf_brand.7: Give me your hand... I have seen this brand, on a rubbing of the old tablet.
strings.story.cs_rf_brand.8: "On the night the Abyssfire burns again, one shall wake from the ashes, bearing five flames, an emptiness at the heart."
strings.story.cs_rf_brand.9: "He who opens the gate shall close it." ...You climbed out of the burn pit, child.
strings.story.cs_rf_brand.10: Who was burned in that pit?
strings.story.cs_rf_whisper.2: You dream of the last battle. On the Red Field three thousand banners burn as one.
strings.story.cs_rf_whisper.4: Not one step back. Whoever retreats is a traitor, executed where he stands.
strings.story.cs_rf_whisper.5: The deserters are dragged onto the ancient dais. When the blades fall, the stone splits.
strings.story.cs_rf_whisper.7: They knocked on my door with blood.
strings.story.cs_rf_whisper.8: And you, child, will light my lamps.
strings.story.cs_rf_whisper.10: Someone who was buried. Like you.
strings.story.cs_rf_whisper.11: You wake by Knellwatch's hearth, your palm burning. There is no wind, yet the bell sways.
strings.story.cs_rf_herd.2: The Corpseherd falls in the middle of the wagon ring, her hand still on the bell.
strings.story.cs_rf_herd.3: She rings it once, softly: "Go home, children... it's dark."
strings.story.cs_rf_herd.4: Around her, one by one, the dead sit down.
strings.story.cs_rf_herd.5: She only wanted to lead them home. I only told her where home was.
strings.story.cs_rf_marshal_falls.2: Who... gave the order... to retreat?
strings.story.cs_rf_marshal_falls.3: He kneels on the dais. The scorched banner on his back finally droops.
strings.story.cs_rf_siege.2: The bell rings with no hand on it.
strings.story.cs_rf_siege.3: To the walls! Everyone who can hold a blade!
strings.story.cs_rf_finale.3: You lay your branded hand on the cold bell.
strings.story.cs_rf_finale.5: The toll sinks down the ley line, all the way to the dais. For the first time, the black fire in the Breach draws back.
strings.story.cs_rf_finale.6.title: The First Flame
strings.story.cs_rf_finale.6.subtitle: The Seal of Veins, relit
strings.story.cs_rf_finale.7: Across the Red Field the dead who still stood lie down, one by one.
strings.story.cs_rf_finale.8: They toll a bell for every name. No one ever tolled one for me.
strings.story.cs_rf_finale.9: The first lamp. Good, child. Keep walking.
strings.story.cs_rf_finale.10: There are living people past the eastern wood, waiting for word.
strings.story.cs_rf_finale.12: I'm going to that tower. Its fire asks no one to pay. The wounded need a herb garden, and a garden needs a keeper.
strings.story.cs_rf_finale.13: May the bell keep you. ...I will always be listening to it.
